Here we check the null model that is used at the end of the analysis pages, on simulated data where we know the truth. The simulated data has the same structure as our dataset (corpora, speakers, number of gestures), and follows the preprocessing: peaks are at least 160 ms apart, `n_sub` is the number of intervals between peaks, and a gesture needs at least one interval.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(lmerTest)
set.seed(2137)

# figures in the html at 300 dpi
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dpi = 300, fig.retina = 1)

# minimum time between peaks in seconds (PEAK_DIST = 4 frames at 25 fps in the preprocessing)
min_gap <- 0.16
```

## Simulated data

With `b = 0`, nothing links submovement duration to the number of submovements.
With `b < 0`, gestures with more submovements are sped up, i.e., a real Menzerath effect.

```{r}
make_data <- function(b = 0, gap = min_gap) {
  n_spk  <- c(ECOLANG = 15, MULTISIMO = 18, GESres = 7, SAGA = 4, SAGAplus = 10, ZHUBO = 1)
  n_gest <- c(ECOLANG = 3718, MULTISIMO = 1188, GESres = 1029, SAGA = 687, SAGAplus = 675, ZHUBO = 86)
  g <- rbindlist(lapply(names(n_spk), function(cc) {
    rate <- rlnorm(n_spk[cc], log(2.5), 0.15)              # peaks per second, per speaker
    s <- sample(n_spk[cc], n_gest[cc], replace = TRUE)
    data.table(corpus = cc, speaker = paste0(cc, "_", s), rate = rate[s])
  }))
  g[, `:=`(gid = seq_len(.N), dur = rlnorm(.N, log(1.4), 0.5))]
  g[, {
    t <- cumsum(gap + rexp(ceiling(dur / gap) + 2, 1 / (1 / rate - gap)))
    t <- t - runif(1) * t[1]
    iv <- diff(t[t <= dur])
    if (length(iv) >= 1) {
      f <- (length(iv) / 4)^b
      list(sub_dur = iv * f, gesture_dur = dur * f, n_sub = length(iv))
    }
  }, by = .(corpus, speaker, gid)]
}

# the same model as on the analysis pages:
# x = number of submovements within speaker, xb = speaker mean, by-speaker random slopes, corpus as fixed effect
add_predictors <- function(d) {
  d <- copy(d)
  d[, spk := paste(corpus, speaker)]
  d[, lx := log(n_sub)]
  # speaker means are taken over gestures
  d[, m := mean(lx[!duplicated(gid)]), by = spk]
  d[, x := (lx - m) / sd(d$lx)]
  d[, xb := (m - mean(d$lx)) / sd(d$lx)]
  d[, y := scale(log(sub_dur))[, 1]]
  d
}

paper_model <- function(d) {
  lmer(y ~ x + xb + corpus + (1 + x | spk) + (1 | gid), data = add_predictors(d),
       control = lmerControl(calc.derivs = FALSE))
}

d0 <- make_data(b = 0)
d1 <- make_data(b = -0.1)
```

## Paper's model, data without a Menzerath effect

```{r}
m0 <- paper_model(d0)
summary(m0)$coefficients
VarCorr(m0)
```

## Null model

```{r}
sim_gesture <- function(dur, mean_iv, gap = min_gap) {
  for (i in 1:1000) {
    t <- cumsum(gap + rexp(ceiling(dur / gap) + 2, 1 / (mean_iv - gap)))
    t <- t - runif(1) * t[1]
    iv <- diff(t[t <= dur])
    if (length(iv) >= 1) return(iv)
  }
  NULL
}

null_slopes <- function(d, nsim = 100) {
  gest <- unique(d[, .(corpus, speaker, gid, gesture_dur, n_sub)])
  # n_sub + 1 is the number of peaks
  gest[, mean_iv := sum(gesture_dur) / sum(n_sub + 1), by = speaker]
  for (r in 1:3) {
    s <- gest[, .(n = length(sim_gesture(gesture_dur, mean_iv))), by = gid]
    gest[s, on = "gid", n_sim := i.n]
    gest[, mean_iv := min_gap + (mean_iv - min_gap) * mean(n_sim) / mean(n_sub), by = speaker]
  }
  sapply(1:nsim, function(k) {
    s <- gest[, .(sub_dur = sim_gesture(gesture_dur, mean_iv)), by = .(corpus, speaker, gid)]
    s[, n_sub := .N, by = gid]
    unname(fixef(paper_model(s))["x"])
  })
}
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# warnings come from the zero gesture variance (see VarCorr above)
null0 <- null_slopes(d0)
m1 <- paper_model(d1)
null1 <- null_slopes(d1)
```

## Results

```{r, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}
res <- rbind(
  no_effect   = c(observed = fixef(m0)[["x"]], null_mean = mean(null0),
                  quantile(null0, c(0.025, 0.975)), p = (1 + sum(null0 <= fixef(m0)[["x"]])) / 101),
  real_effect = c(observed = fixef(m1)[["x"]], null_mean = mean(null1),
                  quantile(null1, c(0.025, 0.975)), p = (1 + sum(null1 <= fixef(m1)[["x"]])) / 101))
round(res, 3)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(null0, main = "b = 0", xlab = "slope", xlim = range(null0, fixef(m0)["x"]))
abline(v = fixef(m0)["x"], col = "red")
hist(null1, main = "b = -0.1", xlab = "slope", xlim = range(null1, fixef(m1)["x"]))
abline(v = fixef(m1)["x"], col = "red")
```

## Per-corpus slopes (as in the analysis pages), data without an effect

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
per_corpus <- function(d) {
  d <- add_predictors(d)
  # one model with a within-speaker slope for each corpus
  mod <- lmer(y ~ 0 + corpus + corpus:x + xb + (1 + x | spk) + (1 | gid), data = d)
  cf <- coef(summary(mod))
  rows <- grep(":x$", rownames(cf), value = TRUE)
  out <- data.table(corpus = sub("^corpus", "", sub(":x$", "", rows)),
                    beta = cf[rows, "Estimate"], p = cf[rows, "Pr(>|t|)"])
  out[d[, .(gestures = uniqueN(gid)), by = corpus], on = "corpus", gestures := i.gestures]
  out[, singular := isSingular(mod)]
  out
}

pc <- per_corpus(d0)
pc[, `:=`(p_bonferroni = p.adjust(p, "bonferroni"), p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))]
pc
```
